docs.title: Garden irrigation schedule
docs.text: The drip lines run at 06:00 for twenty minutes. The timer valve is labelled V3 and sits behind the water butt.

docs.title: Sourdough starter feeding
docs.text: Feed the starter equal weights of flour and water every twelve hours and keep the jar somewhere warm.

docs.title: Lesson on trusting backups
docs.text: Never trust a backup that was not test-restored. Restore one sample file every month to prove the copies can be read.

docs.title: Router firmware fix
docs.text: Firmware 4.2.1 fixed the dropped wifi after sleep. The error string ERR_WIFI_RESUME_0x31 no longer appears in the log.

docs.title: Kayak trip to Loch Marrow
docs.text: Launch from the north jetty, the tide turns at noon, and bring the blue dry bag.

docs.title: Bin collection days
docs.text: The green bin goes out on odd weeks and the brown bin on even weeks, both by 7am on Thursday.

docs.title: Passport renewal
docs.text: Renewal reference PX-7741. The photo needs a plain cream background.

docs.title: Pharmacy order
docs.text: The repeat order for the antihistamine tablets is collected from the pharmacy on the first Monday.

docs.title: Bike maintenance log
docs.text: Replaced the rear brake pads, lubricated the chain with wax, and set the tyre pressure to 60 psi.

docs.title: Chickpea curry
docs.text: Simmer chickpeas with tomato, cumin and coriander for forty minutes, then add spinach at the end.

docs.title: Reading list
docs.text: A book about lighthouses, a field guide to mosses, and a history of canals.

docs.title: Monthly budget sheet
docs.text: Groceries, energy, subscriptions, and a small savings pot. Milk and oats run about nine pounds a week.

docs.title: Vegetable bed layout
docs.text: Beans on the east trellis and courgettes by the water butt. The garden gets full sun after noon.

docs.title: Printer jams
docs.text: The printer jammed again: clear the rear tray and use 80gsm paper. The container print-gateway restarts weekly.

docs.title: Photo sync trouble
docs.text: The compose service photo-sync exited with code 137. Raise its memory limit to 768m.

docs.title: Photo library migration planning
docs.text: Decided to move the photo albums across in batches of fifty and to keep the old library read-only until done.

docs.title: Search index decision
docs.text: Decision: the shared search index rebuilds nightly at 03:00 and keeps two backups.

docs.title: Smoke alarm check
docs.text: Checked every smoke alarm and replaced the battery in the hall one.

docs.title: Holiday itinerary draft
docs.text: Train to the coast, two nights in a guesthouse, and a lantern walk on the second evening.

docs.title: Loft insulation quote
docs.text: The roofer quoted 270mm mineral wool, about five days of work, with the hatch moved.

docs.title: Tax paperwork
docs.text: Keep the payslips and the savings statements together in the blue folder until April.

docs.title: Camping checklist
docs.text: Stove, gas canister, tent pegs, head torches, and the blue tarp.

docs.title: Photo printing offer
docs.text: The high street shop prints photographs on matt paper for twenty pence each.

docs.title: Retry delay discussion
docs.text: Should the retry delay double each time? Yes: use exponential backoff with jitter and cap the wait at one minute.

docs.title: Timestamp storage choice
docs.text: We settled on storing timestamps as UTC milliseconds and converting to local time only when displaying.

docs.title: Nightly backup restore test
docs.text: Agreed to run a test restore of the nightly backup on the first Sunday of every month.

docs.title: Naming the settings screen
docs.text: The settings screen groups options by area; the sidebar entry is named Preferences.

docs.title: Pagination test fix
docs.text: Fixed the flaky pagination unordered by sorting the rows before comparing; the cause was unordered query results.

docs.title: Dry run flag
docs.text: Added a --dry-run flag to the cleanup command and wrote its help text.

docs.title: Shopping message
docs.text: Can you pick up milk and oats on the way home? Sure, and the light bulbs too.

docs.title: Plumber visit
docs.text: The plumber is coming on Tuesday between nine and eleven, so someone needs to be in.

docs.title: Wifi password message
docs.text: The wifi password is printed on the label underneath the router.

docs.title: Parcel delivery
docs.text: The parcel arrived while we were out and was left with the neighbour.

docs.title: Birthday plan
docs.text: Surprise party plan: collect the cake from the corner bakery on Saturday.

docs.title: Passport details kept at home
docs.text: Passport number QZ-5520 expires in March; the passport is kept in the blue folder.

docs.title: Passport details for renewal
docs.text: Passport number PX-3318 expires in June; the passport is kept in the green drawer.

docs.title: Flight booking one
docs.text: Flight BA201 departs Friday at 07:40 from terminal five, seat 14C.

docs.title: Flight booking two
docs.text: Flight BA318 departs Saturday at 09:15 from terminal two, seat 22A.

docs.title: Appointment at the dental surgery
docs.text: Appointment on the fourth at 10:30 at the dental surgery on Mill Road.

docs.title: Appointment at the garage
docs.text: Appointment on the ninth at 14:00 at the garage on Quay Street.

docs.title: Doctor contact one
docs.text: Dr Patel, Hill Road practice, reached by phone.

docs.title: Doctor contact two
docs.text: Dr Okoye, Elm Street practice, reached online.

docs.title: Dentist reminder one
docs.text: Cleo's dentist: the twelfth at 11:00.

docs.title: Dentist reminder two
docs.text: Dev's dentist: the third at 16:00.
